## Purpose and status

Forced dyadic-band entry still leaves the problem of turning a visit into a successful reduction of the original ordinary source. This continuation attacks that gap through invariant labels, complete certificates, and the coefficient literature. **Full Collatz remains OPEN.**

The literature checkpoint adds two Lean modules with **26 audited public statements**, a reviewed written all-frequency rigidity theorem, and an explicit obstruction to an averaged entropy shortcut. The earlier 91 statements remain unchanged. The combined **117 statements across nine added modules** are an audit inventory, not a claim of 117 novel mathematical theorems or a fresh replay of all nine in this round.

**Published head:** `45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6`  
**Tree:** `e59b425614f071933a5f8c371dac6fa2c05802b4`

This draft remains stacked on PR173, with the forced-section baseline frozen at `fa0c9e2a2851e6324391e39c17afcb5913185aec`.

[Literature synthesis](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/LITERATURE_SYNTHESIS.md) · [Scientific entry point](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/README.md) · [Execution and review evidence](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6/reports/2026-11-21-dyadic-descent/literature/README.md)

## Reviewed written result: ordinary Fourier cancellation and a Besicovitch gap

Let T be the shortcut map and let f be an ordinary Boolean label satisfying the exact pointwise equation f(Tn)=f(n). Write L_X(a)=(1/H_X) sum_(n<=X) a(n)/n. Under the note's pinned stationary marginal-density and FLOOR inputs, the new argument proves

```
L_X(f(n) exp(2*pi*i*theta*n)) -> 0
for every fixed real theta that is not an integer.
```

It does not assume that L_X(f) itself has a limit. More generally, the label is asymptotically independent of every fixed continuous observable in the finite-frequency and congruence environment.

If f is nonconstant, the separately pinned logarithmic predecessor input LOG supplies one epsilon_f>0 such that

```
liminf_X L_X(|f-Q|) >= epsilon_f
```

for every fixed finite trigonometric polynomial Q, with arbitrary real frequencies and complex coefficients. The same gap extends to the bounded Besicovitch almost periodic class. Here Besicovitch approximation means closure in limsup_X (1/X) sum_(n<=X) |f(n)-Q(n)|. No convergence rate is required; each approximant is fixed before X tends to infinity.

Thus **Besicovitch almost periodicity of the actual basin-of-one indicator would imply full convergence**, including exclusion of other cycles. The required approximation is not constructed in this PR. This enlarges the earlier periodic-only sufficient regularity class to all real frequencies.

The proof keeps the ordinary even and odd branch changes separately. Their exact factors 1/2 and 3/2, with the odd-image ternary coset, make the density of an unweighted ordinary empirical limit invariant under the compact shortcut map. Affine translation rigidity, a Bernoulli conditional-expectation argument, and common-symbol ternary coupling prove stationary ergodicity. FLOOR and Haar nonsingularity transfer the constant density to the whole compact environment. No almost-everywhere density is evaluated on ordinary integers.

This is a **source-qualified written measure-theoretic proof, not Lean verification**. Fourier cancellation needs the marginal stationary density and FLOOR; the positive gap additionally needs LOG. The newer joint-clock positive-natural-density claim is not used. An independent internal reviewer checked all new Sections 3–8 at the final mathematical byte pin; this is not a new review of every inherited input.

[Complete analytic proof and exact source ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/LITERATURE_RIGIDITY_BRIDGE.md)

## Kernel-checked affine interfaces: 12 statements

`AffineRigidity.lean` proves the algebraic core on additive groups. Invariance under x -> 2x and x -> 3x+w gives equal values at 6x+w and 6x+2w. Surjectivity of multiplication by six yields invariance under translation by w. Cyclic generation gives constancy; dense generation and continuity give the continuous version.

The finite harmonic analogue uses the exact sum-of-squares identity for two permutations to derive separate branch invariance. A genuine additive halving automorphism transfers these results to the shortcut branches x/2 and (3x+w)/2. The surjectivity, permutation, density, and continuity hypotheses are retained explicitly. This is not a formalization of the measurable analytic argument or a conductor-independent spectral bound.

[AffineRigidity.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/AffineRigidity.lean) · [Interface and proof note](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/AFFINE_RIGIDITY.md)

## Kernel-checked sharp certificate obstruction: 14 statements

Set

```
u = 729*j+7
q = 3888*j+37
S = 4*q = 15552*j+148
M = 13824*j+130.
```

For any complete tail certificate for u, every complete child with arbitrary initial even run and arbitrary finite inserted prefix followed by that same literal tail, whose full grade rank is below the parent grades(2,4::tail), satisfies

```
S' <= M
9*S'+14 <= 8*S.
```

The maximum is attained by one initial even step and prefix [2,2,4]. Uniqueness of the ordinary source of a complete suffix and suffix cancellation in the rank reduce the question to two restricted inverse trees. Exact integrality closes both trees by induction over every finite prefix length. There is no prefix search cutoff.

The exact congruences 4^729=1 and 4^385=22 modulo2187 provide an unbounded family of fully certified parent sources with tail [2*(729*m+385)]. The module proves the required unboundedness internally. The family's large suffix gap is explicit: this is not an unbounded family already in the residual alphabet-four normal form.

A further theorem quantifies over **every finite proposed lookahead K**. Some fully certified parent has a positive wanted target within its original interval whose states T^t(n), for all t<=K, lie above every eligible lower-rank child's interval. The target starts a long exact odd run 2^K*Q-1.

The source and target vary with K. This excludes a uniform bounded direct-forward repair for suffix-preserving replacements; it does not produce an infinite bad orbit or exclude deeper suffix edits, unbounded clocks, or asymmetric common-future mergers. The note distinguishes the earlier fixed-clock obstructions in PR178/PR185 and the successful variable-clock AL27 selector in PR185.

[LiteratureCertificate.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/LiteratureCertificate.lean) · [Complete proof, scope, and overlap](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/45354128f890fb479f6c23b547368bcddd9cebe6/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/LITERATURE_CERTIFICATE_BRIDGE.md)

## Explicit control: zero entropy does not construct the missing approximants

The analytic note proves that

```
b(n) = floor(sqrt(floor(log_2 n))) mod2
```

has linear word complexity p_b(L)<=4L, zero topological entropy, and logarithmic color mass one half in the expected proportion in every fixed residue class. Its logarithmic mean shortcut defect tends to zero as O(1/sqrt(log X)). Nevertheless its distance from the Besicovitch almost periodic class is exactly one half.

This sequence is not pointwise invariant: b(1)!=b(T1). It shows precisely that low complexity and vanishing averaged invariance error cannot supply the missing regularity theorem by themselves. It is not a Collatz counterexample.

## Literature and whole-repository reconciliation

The positive argument takes inspiration from Kakutani's random ergodic framework, the distinction between rational and general Besicovitch approximation, and the solenoid dual to Z[1/6]. The exact needed arguments are written out; no multiplicative-function classification or commuting higher-rank rigidity theorem is applied to Collatz labels.

The certificate proof uses complete-certificate rank reasoning in the Dershowitz–Manna tradition and ordinary inverse-tree integrality. The coefficient audit checks Korec's density-one theorem and the recent first-crossing literature against the existing exact affine correction and PR92 orbit-Mellin work. It does not recast existing qualitative coefficient escape as a new theorem or convert almost-all statements into all-source descent.

The earlier reassessment inventories 145 PRs through PR186. A later metadata reconciliation records the observed updated heads of PR175, PR176, PR178, PR180, and PR185. This is not a fresh full proof audit of those branches. Their canonical potential moments, Abel domination, retained-source criteria, witness transport, and variable-clock selectors still leave a global closing obligation.

## Exact remaining closing step

For the analytic route, construct Besicovitch approximants of the actual ordinary basin indicator with each approximant fixed independently of the observation cutoff. The theorem above would then force constancy. This regularity is not established here.

For the certificate route, supply a universally applicable successful dispatcher using operations beyond the excluded suffix-preserving bounded-forward strategy. For the coefficient or transport routes, exclude the remaining escape alternative with the full affine correction or prove the retained-source estimate forcing absorption. No theorem in this checkpoint is represented as having completed those tasks.
